projects.name: Game Sound Con Collaboration
projects.description:
During GSC

We'll be leading the online mixer, we will need 3-5 people to be in charge of each breakout room (starts no earlier than 7am pacific, and ends when the first talk starts)
We'll follow that up by livestreaming a GSC talk directly on Airwiggles
Me and Greg will get free online tickets :sunglasses:


Leading up to GSC

We will make a post on Airwiggles with...
The 10% discount code
Info about the livestream we're doing on Airwiggles
The video(s) we made last year about GSC
We'll give away 3 free online tickets to random commenters on the thread
(need to ask) I'd like to also publish my soundcuts talk I did last year as a 'this is a talk we did last year' (we can put this in the live replays space too)

We want to message all users a link to the post above AND the discount code
We'll also be able to invite 15 airwiggles users to join the online meetup, for free. We'll have to find people/pick these manually, we also want to make sure they actually show up

members.name: Greg Lester
members.motivWhy:
To build cool things with friends and empower the wider audio creative community. 
To have a tangible positive impact, build a company that acts as a vehicle for opportunities.
Because I love challenges and climbing new mountains to get different views and satiate my appetitve for learning that is led by my curiosity.
members.motivWant:
I want to learn skills that would've been unreachable for me in my job. 
I want to build an incredible creative space on- and offline and support that through gear and tools that the company funds, supplies or enables.
members.motivTravel: Mexico, LA, Seattle, Montreal, Germany, Spain, Japan, Nordic countries (Denmark, Sweden, Norway)
members.motivExperiences:
Meeting new people from the game audio community, getting to collaborate with them and learn from their processes (e.g. Mattia Cellotto). 
Hosting in-person events/experiences like an Art of Mondays retreat,
members.motivProducts:
A flexible camera setup from high quality documentaries to podcast style home setup for events with guests or shows with Lewis (cameras, lights, mics, gimbal, storage, etc.) 
Genelec monitors and a gik fitted acoustic studio.

sponsors.name: A Sound Effect
sponsors.notes: Exclusive partner. Present across virtually every event. Co-organises AirCon. Prizes often curated from their indie creator catalogue.

history.prizeDesc: Co-sponsor with BOOM Library — specific products TBC
Kilohearts prizes via ASE store (refund model); Phase Plant 1st, Multipass runners-up
100+ prizes ~$13k total; indie creator packs from Mattia Cellotto, Mindful Audio, Moon Echo Audio, Pole Position Production, Rock The Speakerbox, sonik Sound, Thomas Rex Beverly

sponsors.name: Kilohearts
sponsors.notes: Extremely consistent partner. Featured Phase Plant and plugins heavily. Published an Airwiggles interview on their own blog — relationship is warm and mutual.

history.prizeDesc: Phase Plant (1st prize), Multipass (runners-up) for best breakdown videos

sponsors.name: BOOM Library
